captions.detailed: A compact home-video camcorder with a rounded black rectangular body, a cylindrical front lens barrel with a dark grey outer ring, and a flat side screen mounted on a vertical hinge. The top features a light grey octagonal mode dial with an indicator line sitting on a separate rectangular base. The side screen folds outward on a vertical axis, the front lens ring rotates continuously, and the top mode dial rotates on its local vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact family camcorder using CadQuery. The model should feature a rounded rectangular main body, a front-facing cylindrical lens with a rotatable outer ring, a side screen that rotates outward on a vertical hinge, and a separate octagonal mode dial on the top that rotates continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a box with rounded edges. Model the front lens barrel and rotatable ring using concentric cylinders, and the top mode dial as an octagonal prism (cylinder with 8 sides) on a thin rectangular base. Create the side screen as a thin box on a vertical hinge offset from the main body. Apply dark grey/black materials to the body and lens, and a lighter grey to the top dial controls.
